title: Atlassian CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes says he will buy $250M of company shares after strong Q4 results eased fears that AI could threaten its business model (Nic Fildes/Financial Times)
summary: Nic Fildes / Financial Times: Atlassian CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes says he will buy $250M of company shares after strong Q4 results eased fears that AI could threaten its business model — Mike Cannon-Brookes' move comes as shares in Australian software company soar on strong quarterly sales
